description: Compact projection of immutable P0b evidence. Original measure JSON hashes/sizes are retained. Repeated decoded outputs and source text are omitted; closure file lists and raw profile/heap artifacts are not included. Numeric observation fields, hashes, schedules, eligibility and ledgers are copied from raw JSON.

attempts.measurementClaim: raw observations only; no optimization conclusion is made by the harness
